## What it is

An open-top storage box sized like a shoe box. Pairs with `shoe_box_lid`,
which slips down over the outside.

## Design notes

Wall thickness sets both the side walls and the floor. Sized generically
(no specific shoe or product to fit), so length/width/height are just
sliders — resize freely.

## Don't

- Don't chamfer the inside corners of the cavity: they're excluded from
  polish on purpose (`concave_edges`), since a bevel there reads as a
  modelling mistake rather than a design choice.
- Don't drop `corner_radius` below 8mm: same peel-front reasoning as
  `shoe_box_lid`'s corners.

## Changelog

- Built as an open-top hollow box with a floor and four walls, chamfered
  polish on every edge that doesn't touch the bed or the interior.
- Rounded the four vertical corners (`corner_radius`, 10mm default) so
  the first layer's peel front is a curve instead of a point, matching
  `shoe_box_lid`. Replaces the earlier brim-only approach to adhesion.
